description: This Scala source file defines the UDTRegistration object, which manages mappings between user classes and their User Defined Types (UDTs) in Apache Spark SQL. It includes methods for checking registration, registering new UDTs, and retrieving UDT classes for user classes.

classes.name: UDTRegistration
classes.description: Object managing registration and lookup of User Defined Types (UDTs) for user classes in Spark SQL.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a user class is already registered with a UDT.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new UDT for a user class, with a warning if already registered.

methods.name: getUDTFor
methods.description: Retrieves the Class object of the UDT for a given user class, with error handling if not loadable or not a UDT.
